description: Search book data by title text and/or author over the CoreForge Memory dossier store (~1.17M book dossiers) merged with the CoreForge catalogue. Returns dossier summaries (use book_record for a full dossier) plus catalogue matches. Paid via x402 ($0.01 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.
name: book_search
